preconditions.description: Number of horses and enemy pairs within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in enemy_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each enemy pair consists of distinct horses within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(list(filter(lambda x: x == e, enemy_pairs))) <= 3 for e in range(1, n+1))
preconditions.description: Each horse has at most three enemies.

postconditions.description: Output is a string of '0's and '1's of length n, or '-1' if no valid partition exists.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[j] for i, j in enemy_pairs)
postconditions.description: No horse shares the same party as its enemy.
